title: VDI gate manifest
description: Declares the INTENT of a short (what should be said and shown). The gate checks the rendered mp4 against it. Nothing here describes how the edit was made.

platform.description: Target platforms, comma separated (tiktok, reels, shorts, x)

script_text.description: The intended spoken text (the script), plain sentences

proper_nouns.description: Names, products, handles. Reported for a human listen when the two ASR models do not confirm them; never excused silently

accepted_deviations.description: Owner-accepted differences between script and audio. The ONLY tolerance the gate allows.

caption_band_px.description: y range (at 1920 tall) where burned-in captions live; captions are OCR'd there

path.description: Original take or pickup file (video or audio); the final's speech is located in these by cross-correlation

t0.description: Window start (s) in the final, when the claim is spoken

text.description: Exact text that must be readable: whole line in frame, still, >= 28 px, >= 1.6 s

run_id.description: The real run or capture the footage comes from

source_label.description: On-screen label required when this beat's run differs from its neighbours in the same claim

claim.description: Claim id; adjacent beats in one claim must share run_id or show a readable source_label

spoken.description: The words this beat proves (for humans)

known_blockers.description: Fixtures only: blockers documented by reviewers, used to prove the gate
